# Research Buddy

> A structured AI research collaborator for any domain, carried inside a single versioned Markdown file.

Research Buddy embeds a research method in one `*-source.md` file that you upload to any AI assistant: the agent works one queued topic per session, in two turns, with tiered sources and append-only history. The `research-buddy` CLI (`pip install research-buddy`) scaffolds, validates and versions that file and renders it to a single-file HTML page.
